gap: Unsupported nonlinear response in short online fits; bounded no-fit precursor to one prospective correction.
scope: Read-only exact captured sessions only; no observe, initialization, refit, hyperparameter sweep or claimed improvement. These are selected known failures.

command_swap.contract: Require identical model weights. Evaluate the 2x2 combinations of real observation+past-command history from these origins and their two issued current commands. Keep each real past history intact and reconstruct its filter/memory. Use float64 native and64x refined integration, and start head decomposition. Only the two original diagonal pairs have observed successor truth; label off-diagonal outcomes counterfactual with no truth error.

support.points: All20 declared causal snapshots, each at its observed origin and all original native start/midpoint states.
support.cache: Retained bootstrap/recent forecast origins only, equal nonempty roles and equal windows within role; no current query or target added. Construct actual current, delayed-difference and hidden features using each real context under captured weights.
support.basis: Invertible affine change of complete linear/quadratic head basis: supported normalized motion multiplied by original body_scale (startup-centered physical motion); raw unit gravity direction; issued/filtered commands in declared units minus original input_mean; delayed differences in these coordinates; hidden unchanged. Include affine intercept. Exactly transform existing coefficients including quadratic-to-linear/intercept terms. Do not replace supported motion with unbounded raw motion.
support.decomposition: Separate unchanged nonlinear neural-head contribution. Independently reconstruct affine+quadratic physical acceleration from transformed features/coefficients and check at all retained rows/queries within1e-9 absolute+relative.
support.svd: Weight rows by sqrt(role/window weight). SVD rank tolerance max(matrix.shape)*float64_epsilon*largest_singular_value; empty/zero matrix has rank0. Save spectra/ranks. Report rowspace and right-null projection energy fractions and weighted leverage for affine, quadratic and combined features; zero-query fraction is undefined.
support.conditional_quadratic: Use full SVD of A. B=A^+Q. Form independently constrained quadratic design U_perp.T@Q and query q_perp=q-aB. If rank(A)==N, independent design has exactly zero rows. Report support/null fractions; do not manufacture rank from subtraction roundoff.
support.coefficient_attribution: Transform actual affine+quadratic coefficients exactly. Project them onto combined design right-nullspace; report query acceleration contribution and retained-design null response, with reconstruction checks. Separately report conditional quadratic contribution q_perp @ beta_Q and its unsupported projection. These are algebraic decompositions of existing coefficients, not fitted alternative dynamics.
support.limits: Ranks show numerical identifiability at frozen observed origins, not identifiability under integrated training targets or statistical uncertainty. Contributions/projection magnitudes depend on the explicitly declared physical basis. Marginal command rank does not imply nonlinear response identifiability.

precision: Scopedfloat64 same pinned runtime as causal trace, ambient32 restored. Source committed before execution. No prediction counterfactual is called a measured error.
evidence: Save source binding, reference authority, JSON/NPZ outputs and manifest in a new exclusive directory; no source snapshot mutation. Analytic coefficient-transform/nullspace tests before run.
decision: Use diagnosis to choose one generic correction; freeze separate full v6 comparison before fitting. No adoption decision from selected snapshots.
